name: main
comment: creates the "ode" device/driver (xbus proxy) and the ram proxy device, AllocSignal, waits

name: xbus_proxy_init
comment: Starting xbus proxy: opens "xbus", creates cmd IOReq (+0xbc) and rw IOReq (+0xc0)

name: ode_abortio
comment: AbortIO on the matching xbus IOReq

name: ode_dispatch
comment: CREATEDRIVER_TAG_DISPATCH (tags @0x19c8). cmd 13: return status byte; cmd 12: data phase (rw IOReq, CMD_READ/WRITE) + XBus CmdCommand(3); other: pass through

name: ramp_cmd_write
comment: CmdTable[0] @0x1a0c. unit (from *ioi_User) 0: memcpy(ioi_Offset, Send.buf, Send.len) = supervisor memory write; 3: forward to "ram" device; others rejected

name: ramp_cmd_read
comment: CmdTable[1]. unit 0: memcpy(Recv.buf, ioi_Offset, Recv.len) = supervisor memory read (ROM, chip regs); else forward to "ram" device

name: ramp_init
comment: opens a "ram" device item and creates an IOReq (+0xc8)

name: dev_stub_ret0_a
comment: mov r1,r0; mov r0,#0 (device/driver callback stub)

name: SuperDo
comment: kernellib supervectors.s: ldr pc,[KernelBase,-(MaxUserFunctions+k+1)*4]; byte-identical to SuperGrafDo
